```{r}
#first library a few packages that we will use during the practical
#note you may need to install them first...
library(spatstat)
library(here)
library(sp)
library(tmap)
library(sf)
library(tmaptools)
```
```{r}
##First, get the London Borough Boundaries
LondonBoroughs <- st_read(here::here("data", "wk1","statistical-gis-boundaries-london","statistical-gis-boundaries-london", "ESRI", "London_Borough_Excluding_MHW.shp"))
# Or use this to read in directly.
#LondonBoroughs <- st_read("https://opendata.arcgis.com/datasets/8edafbe3276d4b56aec60991cbddda50_4.geojson")
```
```{r}
library(stringr)
BoroughMap <- LondonBoroughs %>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(GSS_CODE, "^E09"))%>%
  st_transform(., 27700)

qtm(BoroughMap)
```
```{r}
summary(BoroughMap)
```
```{r}
##Now get the location of all Blue Plaques in the City
#BluePlaques <- st_read("https://s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/openplaques/open-plaques-london-2018-04-08.geojson")
BluePlaques <- st_read(here::here("data","wk6",
                                  "open-plaques-london-2018-04-08.geojson")) %>%
  st_transform(.,27700)
```
```{r}
summary(BluePlaques)
```
```{r}
#plot the blue plaques in the city
tmap_mode("plot")

tm_shape(BoroughMap) +
  tm_polygons(fill_alpha = 0.5)+
tm_shape(BluePlaques) +
  tm_dots(fill = "blue", size=0.1)
```
```{r}
#remove duplicates
library(tidyverse)

library(sf)
BluePlaques <- distinct(BluePlaques)
```
```{r}
BluePlaquesSub <- BluePlaques[BoroughMap,]
# 根据 BoroughMap 的伦敦自治市面边界，对 BluePlaques 点数据进行空间筛选，保留与边界相交的点，并将结果保存为 BluePlaquesSub

#plot the blue plaques in the city
tmap_mode("plot")

#check to see that they've been removed
tm_shape(BoroughMap) +
  tm_polygons(fill_alpha = 0.5)+
tm_shape(BluePlaquesSub) +
  tm_dots(fill = "blue", size=0.1)
```
```{r}
# add sparse=false to get the complete matrix.
# this is the same as select by location in QGIS
# filter from dplyr is the same as select by attribute 
intersect_indices <-st_intersects(BoroughMap, BluePlaques)
# 逐个检查 BoroughMap 中的行政区，返回落在各区内部或边界上的蓝牌在 BluePlaques 中的行号
```
```{r}
#extract the borough
# select by attribute
Harrow <- BoroughMap %>%
  filter(., NAME=="Harrow")

#Check to see that the correct borough has been pulled out
tm_shape(Harrow) +
  tm_polygons(col = NA, fill_alpha = 0.5)
```
```{r}
#clip the data to our single borough
BluePlaquesSub <- BluePlaques[Harrow,] #对象[选哪些行, 选哪些列]

#check that it's worked
tm_shape(Harrow) +
  tm_polygons(fill_alpha = 0.5)+
tm_shape(BluePlaquesSub) +
  tm_dots(fill = "blue", size=0.1)
```
```{r}
#now set a window as the borough boundary
window <- as.owin(Harrow)# 把 Harrow 的多边形转换成 spatstat 能识别的观测窗口
plot(window)
```
```{r}
#create a sp object
BluePlaquesSub<- BluePlaquesSub %>%
  as(., 'Spatial') # 把蓝牌点转成 sp 格式，方便下一步用 @coords 提取坐标
#create a ppp object
BluePlaquesSub.ppp <- ppp(x=BluePlaquesSub@coords[,1], # 取所有行的第 1 列，得到 x
                          y=BluePlaquesSub@coords[,2], # 取所有行的第 2 列，得到 y
                          window=window)
```
```{r}
BluePlaquesSub@coords[,1]
```
```{r}
BluePlaquesSub.ppp %>%
  plot(.,
       pch=16, # 用实心圆表示蓝牌
       cex=0.5, # 点的大小设为默认的 0.5 倍
       main="Blue Plaques Harrow")  #设置图标题
```
```{r}
BluePlaquesSub.ppp %>% # 输入蓝牌点和 Harrow 的观测范围
  density(., sigma=500) %>% # 用 500 米带宽估计各处的蓝牌密度
  plot() # 把估计出的密度画成图
```
```{r}
BluePlaquesSub.ppp %>%
  density(., sigma=1000) %>%
  plot()
```
```{r}
#First plot the points
# 第一层：画出 Harrow 边界和蓝牌点
plot(BluePlaquesSub.ppp,
     pch=16,
     cex=0.5, 
     main="Blue Plaques in Harrow")

# 第二层：划分样方，统计每格的蓝牌数，并叠加到原图上
#now count the points in that fall in a 6 x 6
#grid overlaid across the windowBluePlaquesSub.ppp2<-BluePlaquesSub.ppp %>%
BluePlaquesSub.ppp %>%
  quadratcount(.,nx = 6, ny = 6)%>% # 横向分 6 列，纵向分 6 行
    plot(., add=T, col="red") # 在原图上用红色画出格线和计数
```
```{r}
#run the quadrat count
Qcount <- BluePlaquesSub.ppp %>%
  quadratcount(.,nx = 6, ny = 6) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% # 转成数据框，每行对应一个格子
  dplyr::count(Var1=Freq)%>% 
  # 按蓝牌数分组（`Var1 = Freq` 的意思是“用 Freq 的值来分组，并把结果里的分组列叫作 Var1”。），数每组有几个格子（`count()` 自动把这个结果放进一列，默认列名叫 n。）
  dplyr::rename(Freqquadratcount=n) # 把格子数量这一列从 n 改名为 Freqquadratcount
```
```{r}
Qcount %>% 
  summarise_all(class)
```
```{r}
sums <- Qcount %>%
  #calculate the total blue plaques (Var * Freq)
  mutate(total = Var1 * Freqquadratcount) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(everything(), sum))%>%
  dplyr::select(-Var1) 

lambda<- Qcount%>%
  #calculate lambda
  mutate(total = Var1 * Freqquadratcount)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
  mutate(lambda=total/Freqquadratcount) %>%
  dplyr::select(lambda)%>%
  pull(lambda) #把lambda取出来
```
```{r}
QCountTable <- Qcount %>%
  mutate(Pr=((lambda^Var1)*exp(-lambda))/factorial(Var1))%>%
  #now calculate the expected counts based on our total number of plaques
  #and save them to the table
  mutate(Expected= (round(Pr * sums$Freqquadratcount, 0)))

#Compare the frequency distributions of the observed and expected point patterns
plot(c(1,5),c(0,14), type="n",
#先建一张空图，设定横纵轴范围。`type="n"` 表示暂时不画数据。
xlab="Number of Blue Plaques (Red=Observed,Blue=Expected)", 
     ylab="Frequency of Occurances",
     xaxt="n")
axis(side=1, at=1:5, labels=0:4)
points(QCountTable$Freqquadratcount, 
       col="Red", 
       type="o", 
       lwd=3)
#画出实际格子数，用红色表示。`type="o" 表示画点并连线，lwd=3` 设置线宽。画出实际格子数，用红色表示。`type="o" 表示画点并连线，lwd=3` 设置线宽。
points(QCountTable$Expected, col="Blue", 
       type="o", 
       lwd=3)
#在同一张图上画出预期格子数，用蓝色表示。
```
```{r}
teststats <- quadrat.test(BluePlaquesSub.ppp, nx = 6, ny = 6) 
# 用 6 列 × 6 行的网格检验 Harrow 蓝牌的分布是否偏离完全空间随机（CSR），把结果存入 teststats
```
```{r}
plot(BluePlaquesSub.ppp,pch=16,cex=0.5, main="Blue Plaques in Harrow")
plot(teststats, add=T, col = "red")
# 左上是实际蓝牌数，右上是 CSR 下的预期数，下方是残差。
```
```{r}
K <- BluePlaquesSub.ppp %>%
  Kest(., correction="border") %>% # 估计不同半径下的 K 值，校正边界影响
  plot()
```
```{r}
# we can also extract the plot into a dataframe
Kval <- as.data.frame(Kest(BluePlaquesSub.ppp, correction = "Ripley"))
```

library(fpc)

```{r}
#first check the coordinate reference system of the Harrow spatial polygon:
st_geometry(BoroughMap)
```
```{r}
#first extract the points from the spatial points data frame
BluePlaquesSubPoints <- BluePlaquesSub %>%
  coordinates(.)%>%
  as.data.frame()

#now run the dbscan analysis
db <- BluePlaquesSubPoints %>%
  fpc::dbscan(.,eps = 700, MinPts = 4)

#now plot the results
plot(db, BluePlaquesSubPoints, main = "DBSCAN Output", frame = F)
plot(BoroughMap$geometry, add=T)
```
```{r}
# used to find suitable eps value based on the knee in plot
# k is no of nearest neighbours used, use min points
library(dbscan)

BluePlaquesSubPoints%>%
  dbscan::kNNdistplot(.,k=4)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```
```{r}
db
```
```{r}
db$cluster# 查看每块蓝牌的簇编号
```
```{r}
BluePlaquesSubPoints<- BluePlaquesSubPoints %>%
  mutate(dbcluster=db$cluster)
```
```{r}
# convert the data frame to sf
BluePlaquesSubPoints_sf <- st_as_sf(BluePlaquesSubPoints, 
                                    coords = c("coords.x1", "coords.x2"), 
                                    crs = 27700)

# make the convex hulls around the cluster points
chull_polygons <- BluePlaquesSubPoints_sf %>%
  # remove any points not in a cluster
  filter(dbcluster>0)%>% #去掉编号为 0 的噪声点，只保留已归入某个簇的蓝牌
  group_by(dbcluster) %>% #按簇编号分组，让每个簇单独计算轮廓
  summarise(geometry = st_combine(geometry)) %>%  # combine points
  #把同一簇的多个点收进一个 MULTIPOINT。现在每行代表一个簇，里面保留着该簇所有蓝牌的位置。
  mutate(geometry = st_convex_hull(geometry)) %>% # convex hull
  #把每簇的点集合转换成包住它们的最小凸多边形
  st_as_sf()
```

```{r}
library(ggspatial)
```
```{r}
# Create the map
ggplot() +
  annotation_map_tile(zoom = 13) +
  geom_sf(data = BluePlaquesSubPoints_sf, aes(color=dbcluster), size = 3)+
  geom_sf(data = chull_polygons, aes(fill = dbcluster), 
          alpha = 0.8, 
          # remove polygon borders
          color = NA, 
          show.legend = FALSE) +

  theme_bw()
```
